content.short: Regulated by the CFTC, Kalshi lets people trade event contracts on politics, sports, economics, weather and more.
content.description: Kalshi was the first exchange regulated by the US CFTC to offer event contracts directly to the public. Each contract asks a yes or no question about a future event and pays a fixed amount if the answer is yes, so the price works like a market probability. Topics range from elections and Fed decisions to sports, culture, crypto prices and the weather. Each event contract has a defined payout, and markets cover categories as wide as entertainment and weather alongside politics, sports and crypto.
content.meta: US-regulated prediction exchange for trading yes or no contracts on real-world events. Explore Kalshi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
